summary: St. John the Evangelist, Schenectady shares a bulletin with St. Kateri Tekakwitha and St. Anthony's. Its own Saturday 4:00 PM and Sunday 10:30 AM Masses are printed in the Mass Times box of all three bulletins (confession is by appointment only, so left out); the other clusters' Masses are left out as other parishes' churches. One question: the Wednesday and Thursday 9:00 AM Masses at St. John appear only in the weekly calendar, never in the schedule box or the website, so the reviewer decides whether they are weekly or only the dated Masses of Oct 14 and 15.

slots.rationale:
C1, POLICY rule 4/5: the weekly calendar (page 4) of all three bulletins shows a 9:00 AM Wednesday Mass at St. John (the cluster rotates weekday Masses among St. John, St. Kateri and St. Anthony's), but the Mass Times box (page 1: Saturday and Sunday only) and the website list no weekday Mass. Like C1, a Mass only in the weekly listing, so not a weekly slot on this evidence. The dated Mass in the newest bulletin (2026-10-14) is on or after as_of and printed with its date, so I lean toward recording just that; update mode promotes it to weekly if it keeps recurring (POLICY rule 5). History has it weekly (only from the newest bulletin).

Review 2026-10-22: Prefer weekly Wednesday/Thursday 9 AM if repeated dated calendars across bulletins are sufficient. The three calendars agree; the header describes weekend Masses, so omission does not by itself disprove weekdays. This reverses the agent’s dated-only lean.
